subject: Re: Novared demo reschedule — scope trimmed, moving timeline
messages:
From: Alex Dobson <alex@novared.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
Cc: product@novared.com
Date: Mon, 20 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood demo next week

Sean —

Quick update from our side: leadership just did a product reset and we had to trim the scope of the Q3 initiatives. The inference/LLM track is being deprioritized in favor of an analytics sprint that starts this week.

Because of that, we need to pause the detailed demo you had planned for next Tuesday. We still want to see Redwood, but the internal owners asked that we push any heavy technical sessions into Q4 so they can re-evaluate priorities after the analytics work.

Can you do two things for us?
1) Move the demo to a tentative Q4 window (we're thinking early- to mid-December).
2) Share an updated mutual action plan (MAP) that shows a trimmed scope (no real-time inference PoC, just batch embedding and cost estimates) and a simplified deliverables list so our PMs can review quickly.

Looping in procurement (procurement@novared.com) in case there are questions about the pilot terms.

Appreciate the flexibility — apologies for the churn.

Thanks,
Alex
Alex Dobson
Head of Product — Novared

From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Dobson <alex@novared.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 20 Sep 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood demo next week

Thanks for the heads-up, Alex — totally understand. Roadmap repriorits happen.

We can do that. Proposed next steps from our side:
- I will tentatively open a Q4 slot (Dec 6 or Dec 9) as you suggested — we won't block anything firm on your calendar until you confirm.
- Camila, can you produce a trimmed MAP that focuses on batch embeddings + a 2-week pilot outline (no real-time serving)? Please include high-level cost guidance and expected token/unit economics.
- Monica, I'll loop you for any CS onboarding notes that might help shorten procurement cycles.

Alex — do either of those dates (Dec 6 or Dec 9) look feasible for you right now as a placeholder? If not, tell me the best weeks in early December and we'll keep it tentative.

I'll also attach a single-page MAP sketch for your PMs to glance at (Camila will follow up with a cleaner version).

Best,
Sean Gallagher
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
sean_gallagher@redwood.ai
T: +1 (415) 555-0123

From: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>, Alex Dobson <alex@novared.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2026 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood demo next week

Alex — thanks for the update. I skimmed the trimmed scope and have a couple of quick notes for the MAP:
- We can switch the PoC to a 2-week batch embedding run: ingest ~250k records, run embedding generation, and deliver sample similarity queries + cost report.
- We'll remove the streaming/real-time section and any autoscaling commitments from the initial MAP.
- Performance notes: I'll include 95th/median latency baselines for our hosted models and an estimate for on-prem pricing if you ask for that later.

Attached is a first draft of the trimmed MAP (Novared-MAP-draft-v2.pdf). It's a one-pager + scope bullets. If you want a 30-minute technical drop-in instead of a full demo next month, I can do that as well — narrower goal: validate data schema and expected throughput.

Camila
Camila Reyes
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
camila_reyes@redwood.ai
Attachment: Novared-MAP-draft-v2.pdf (PDF, 1 page)

From: Alex Dobson <alex@novared.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
Cc: product@novared.com, procurement@novared.com
Date: Fri, 24 Sep 2026 11:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood demo next week

Thanks, Camila and Sean — the draft looks sensible and precisely what our PMs asked for. Procurment looped in and will review the pilot terms.

For timing: we want to keep this on our radar but not block engineering until our analytics sprint wraps up. Can you tentatively slot Dec 6 (afternoon PST) as the demo+MAP review? We'll treat it as tentative and confirm two weeks before. If that window becomes tight, we'll push to the week of Dec 13.

Also: we need the MAP with cost bands (low/mid/high) because finance wants an initial sizing to evaluate the pilot spend. Can you add that to the MAP?

Alex

From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Dobson <alex@novared.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, procurement@novared.com
Date: Mon, 27 Sep 2026 15:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood demo next week

Alex — great, thank you.

Final plan we agreed internally and are sharing with you:
1) Tentative demo + MAP review: Dec 6, 2026, 1:00–1:45pm PST (we'll move if Novared confirms a different pref). Calendar invite (ICS) attached for you to accept/decline.
2) Camila will deliver a revised MAP by Sep 30 with low/mid/high cost bands and a 2-week batch-embedding pilot outline.
3) If you prefer a short 30-minute technical sync instead of the 45-minute demo while your analytics sprint wraps, Camila is available the week of Nov 2 for a technical drop-in to validate data shape.
4) Monica will prepare a short onboarding checklist for procurement to speed the pilot kick-off once Novared gives the green light.

I'll add the tentative invite to the deal in HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/4982 and attach the ICS here.

Thanks for being transparent — happy to keep this light and reconvene when you're ready.

Action items: Camila (MAP w/ cost bands by 2026-09-30), Sean (create tentative calendar invite + HubSpot note), Monica (CS onboarding checklist).

Best,
Sean Gallagher
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
sean_gallagher@redwood.ai
Attachment: calendar-ics-event.ics (ICS, tentative invite)
